fonts.display: 'sans-serif', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Hanken Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Linen Canvas
palette.role: Page background, hero gradient origin — warm cream base that absorbs the entire site into a unified off-white

palette.name: Bone White
palette.role: Card surfaces, section backgrounds, raised panels against the linen canvas

palette.name: Graphite Ink
palette.role: Primary text, dominant border color across cards and sections — the system's typographic anchor

palette.name: Nightshade Black
palette.role: Primary action button fill, footer background — near-black with a faint cool undertone

palette.name: Deep Harbor
palette.role: Alternate dark surface, nav background — indistinguishable from Nightshade but carries a subtle navy tilt

palette.name: Charcoal Slate
palette.role: Body borders, secondary surfaces, image card borders — slightly softer than pure black

palette.name: Iron Grey
palette.role: Icon strokes, heading borders, secondary fills — mid-dark neutral for iconography

palette.name: Obsidian
palette.role: Nav text, body borders — the darkest readable neutral after Nightshade

palette.name: Stone Grey
palette.role: Muted body text, default body border — the primary mid-grey for paragraph copy and dividers

palette.name: Ash
palette.role: Helper text, icon strokes, link borders — lighter mid-grey for secondary metadata

palette.name: Pebble
palette.role: Subtle body borders, low-emphasis copy — barely-there dividers

palette.name: Concrete
palette.role: Faint body text and dividers — used sparingly for ultra-low emphasis

palette.name: Dove
palette.role: Button border, icon fill, disabled-state borders — the lightest mid-tone

palette.name: Clay Shadow
palette.role: Soft shadow color, card box-shadows, subtle background fills — warm-tinted shadow grey that matches the canvas

palette.name: Haze
palette.role: Subtle card borders, low-contrast dividers — the cool counterpoint to Clay Shadow
